Name: Ahira, Son of Enan
Summary: Ahira, son of Enan, was the prince of the tribe of Naphtali at the census in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Ahira led Naphtali's 53,400 men and brought the tribe's offering for the dedication of the altar.
LifeLesson: The last tribe in line is still named, counted, and given its offering.
